circular_interrogation.firm: Could we keep this to one specific factual question? I can follow up in writing after checking it.

moving_goalposts.yellow: Happy to review the change. Could we compare the previous requirement with this request and confirm the acceptance criteria?
moving_goalposts.firm: Please confirm what has changed, the current acceptance criteria and any effect on priority or timing.

competing_priorities.yellow: I want to plan this accurately. Could we rank these tasks and agree what can wait?
competing_priorities.firm: Before I commit to a delivery time, please confirm which task takes precedence and what can move.

credit_dispute.grey: Could we check the contribution record for this deliverable?
credit_dispute.yellow: For accuracy, could we review who contributed to each part and confirm the attribution?
credit_dispute.firm: Please review the documented contributions and correct any attribution that does not match the record.

no_response.firm: Please confirm which decision is still needed, who can make it and when I can expect an answer.

ordinary_disagreement.firm: Could we compare the options against the decision criteria before committing?
